summary: The diff addresses both REQ-1 (remove PDF export UI from ExportTab.tsx) and REQ-2 (fix Save project mutation). REQ-1 appears fully implemented — ExportTab.tsx no longer contains PDF UI elements and only shows CSV export. REQ-2 shows a fully implemented saveProject mutation in useQueries.ts with proper field mapping. However, there is no direct evidence in the diff of success/error toast handling wired up in DashboardHeader.tsx or ProjectContext.tsx for the save action, which is part of REQ-2's acceptance criteria.

missing_requirements.requirement: A success toast is displayed after a successful save, and an error toast is displayed if the save fails with a meaningful message.
missing_requirements.reason: The diff shows the useSaveProjectMutation hook in useQueries.ts but does not show changes to DashboardHeader.tsx or ProjectContext.tsx where the toast notifications would be wired up on save success/failure. The frontend-file-summaries.txt mentions DashboardHeader has save functionality but no diff content confirms toast calls were added.

hallucinated_features.description: A backend migration module (migration.mo) was added with empty OldActor and NewActor types and a trivial run function.
hallucinated_features.reason: Neither REQ-1 nor REQ-2 requested any backend migration scaffolding. The build request focused solely on frontend UI removal and fixing the save mutation flow.
